measures.title: Constitutional Amendment Proposed by the 2026 General Court (CACR 13): Eliminating the Office of Register of Probate
measures.summary: This legislatively referred amendment would remove the elected county office of register of probate from the New Hampshire Constitution by rewriting Part II, Articles 71 and 81. Most of the office's duties were eliminated in a 2011 reorganization of the state courts. It needs approval from two-thirds of those voting on the question; a similar amendment fell short of that threshold in 2022.
measures.yesMeans: You favor removing the register of probate from the state constitution, eliminating the elected office.
measures.noMeans: The constitution keeps the register of probate as an elected county office.
